about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The South Rent Car story and our vision for car rental in the Kingdom
about.storyBody1: South Rent Car started from a simple idea: every visitor and every resident in Jordan should get a car worthy of their journey, with no complications and no surprises on the bill.
about.storyBody2: Today we run a fleet of modern tourism vehicles, branches in Amman and Aqaba, and a team that works around the clock to make sure your trip starts exactly on time.
about.missionBody: To make renting a premium car in Jordan simple, transparent and dependable, from booking to handing over the key.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains what we collect and how we use it.
privacy.collectBody: We collect your name, email and phone number when you create an account, photos of your ID and driving licence when you complete a booking, plus your booking and payment history.
privacy.useBody: We use your data to process bookings, verify driving eligibility, contact you about your reservation, and improve our service. We do not use it for anything else without your permission.
privacy.shareBody: We do not sell your data. We share it only with payment providers to complete a transaction, and with authorities where we have a legal obligation.
privacy.securityBody: Passwords are stored hashed and data is transmitted over an encrypted connection. Access to customer documents is limited to authorised staff.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting us.
privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question, write to info@drivejordan.jo

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using the South Rent Car website and booking a car through it, you agree to the following terms.
terms.eligibilityBody: The renter must be at least 21 years old, hold a driving licence valid for at least one year, and present a valid ID or passport.
terms.bookingBody: Every booking request is subject to review and document verification. The minimum rental is 3 days, rising to 7 days during peak seasons. A booking is confirmed only once approved.
terms.paymentBody: The deposit is paid at pickup and refunded in full when the car is returned in its original condition. Seasonal rates published at the time of booking apply.
terms.cancellationBody: Bookings may be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before pickup. Later cancellations may incur a one-day charge.
terms.liabilityBody: The renter is responsible for traffic fines and any damage not covered by insurance during the rental period. Taking the vehicle outside the Kingdom requires written permission.
terms.pointsBody: Completed bookings earn 10 points per JOD, and every 100 points is worth 1 JOD off a future rental. Points are non-transferable and hold no cash value.
terms.contactBody: For questions about these terms, write to info@drivejordan.jo
